headlines.title: The Monopolistic Razor-and-Blade Engine I Can’t Stop Buying
headlines.summary: A 26% price drop on a stock with a near-monopoly business model and 85% recurring revenue sounds like a warning, but one investor sees it as an invitation to keep buying.

headlines.title: Should Barclays’ Bullish Initiation Amid Rising Rivalry Require Action From Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) Investors?
headlines.summary: In early October 2026, Barclays initiated coverage of Intuitive Surgical, describing it as a high‑quality healthcare equipment company amid a softer medical devices backdrop, while investors looked ahead to the company’s then-upcoming October 20 earnings release expected to show year-over-year growth in earnings per share and revenue.

headlines.title: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) and JNJ Give Jim Cramer More Than Valuation to Consider
headlines.summary: During the October 5 episode of Mad Money, a caller asked whether Intuitive Surgical, Inc. (NASDAQ:ISRG) was a broken stock and whether they should consider buying it. Jim Cramer replied: I don’t like that particular business anymore because there’s too many companies that want to be in it, particularly Johnson & Johnson.

headlines.title: Can ISRG's Single-Port Platform Become the Next Billion-Dollar Franchise?
headlines.summary: Intuitive Surgical SP platform is gaining momentum as procedures, utilization and placements rise, with expanding indications and global adoption fueling growth.

headlines.title: Here Are Wednesday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Abbott Laboratories, AppFolio, Delek US Holdings, Flutter Entertainment, Honeywell Aerospace,  Intuitive Surgical, Marvell, NetApp, and More
headlines.summary: Stocks shattered records again Tuesday while oil surged, gold hit new highs, and crypto swung wildly, setting the stage for a fresh wave of analyst moves on names like Marvell, Intuitive Surgical, and NetApp that could reshape portfolios heading into the rest of the week.

description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. develops, manufactures, and markets products that enable physicians and healthcare providers to enhance the quality of and access to minimally invasive care in the United States and internationally. It offers the da Vinci Surgical System that enables surgical procedures using a minimally invasive approach; and Ion endoluminal system, which extends its commercial offerings beyond surgery into diagnostic endoluminal procedures enabling minimally invasive biopsies in the lung. The company also provides a suite of stapling, energy, and core instrumentation for its multi-port da Vinci surgical systems; progressive learning pathways to support the use of its technology; infrastructure of customer service and support specialists, a complement of services to its customers, including installation, repair, maintenance, 24/7 technical support, and proactive system health monitoring; and integrated digital capabilities providing connected offerings, streamlining performance for hospitals with program-enhancing insights. It sells its products through direct sales organizations, such as capital and clinical sales teams. Intuitive Surgical, Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
